name: MDLIVE vs Teladoc Health
title: MDLIVE vs Teladoc Health: Enterprise Telehealth Giants Compared
description: Compare MDLIVE (Cigna/Evernorth subsidiary, 24/7 access) vs Teladoc Health (90M+ members, BetterHelp owner, NASDAQ-listed). Two telehealth industry leaders.

summary.bottom_line: MDLIVE and Teladoc Health are the two largest telehealth platforms in the US. MDLIVE is now a Cigna/Evernorth subsidiary with seamless integration for Cigna members. Teladoc is the largest independent telehealth company (90M+ members, NASDAQ: TDOC) and owns BetterHelp. Both offer 24/7 access to medical, behavioral health, and dermatology services. Choice often depends on your insurance carrier.

sections.heading: Two Telehealth Giants
sections.content: MDLIVE and Teladoc Health dominate enterprise telehealth. MDLIVE was acquired by Cigna's Evernorth in 2021, making it the default telehealth for Cigna members. Teladoc remains independent and publicly traded, serving 90M+ members across multiple insurers. Teladoc also owns BetterHelp, the largest online therapy platform. Both offer comprehensive services: urgent care, mental health, chronic care, and dermatology.

sections.heading: Cost Comparison
sections.content: Pricing is similar and heavily insurance-dependent. With insurance, both range from $0-75 for general medical visits. Self-pay therapy: MDLIVE $179 initial vs Teladoc/BetterHelp $65-100/week. Self-pay psychiatry: MDLIVE $284 initial vs Teladoc $199-299. The real difference is insurance integration - Cigna members get seamless MDLIVE access, while Teladoc has the broadest insurer network.

sections.heading: The BetterHelp Factor
sections.content: Teladoc's acquisition of BetterHelp gives them the largest therapy network. BetterHelp offers unlimited messaging plus weekly sessions for $65-100/week - a different model than traditional per-session pricing. MDLIVE uses traditional session-based therapy. If you want unlimited therapist messaging between sessions, Teladoc/BetterHelp has an advantage.

recommendations.when: You have Cigna insurance - MDLIVE is now part of Cigna's Evernorth with seamless integration.
You have Aetna, UnitedHealthcare, or other major insurers - Teladoc has the broadest network.
You want unlimited therapist messaging between sessions with subscription-based pricing.
You need 24/7 urgent care access - both offer comparable same-day doctor visits.

faqs.q: Which has better mental health services?
faqs.a: Both offer psychiatry and therapy. Teladoc's BetterHelp offers unlimited messaging, which some prefer. MDLIVE has traditional session-based care. Quality is comparable - choose based on the care model you prefer.

faqs.q: Can I use either without insurance?
faqs.a: Yes. Both offer self-pay options. General medical visits start around $75, therapy $100-200 per session. BetterHelp's subscription model ($65-100/wk) can be more economical for frequent therapy.
